description.narrative:
AMQF har ansökt om en kostnadsförlängning av ett redan pågående Sida-finansierat program med 13 162 000 kronor för 2014 - 2015. Programmet har pågått sedan 2012 och syftar till att utföra aktiviteter som upprätthåller nätverket för scenkonst. Den totala budgeten för programmets fyra år uppnår med förlängningen 26 288 000 SEK.
Programmet har som mål att bidra till utvecklingen av ett demokratiskt och pluralistiskt samhälle som respekterar mänskliga rättigheter och stärker palestinsk kultur och identitet. AMQF genomför insatsen i samarbete med 9 organisationer som arbetar med scenkonst.

Support to a performing arts programme on the West Bank and Gaza, with main components of music education, dance, drama and trauma therapy. The target groups are children and youth, especially girls, from poor families/areas.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The launching of the first Palestinian Performing Arts Network in Palestine was the highlight of 2015 achievements. Institutionalisation process is an ongoing process led by coordinated efforts of the Network Board of Directors and management team. It already led to complete implementation of the Network's annual activities with a special focus on advocacy activities. The Network productions, performances and festivals organised for the various Palestinian communities across the West Bank including East Jerusalem and Area C and Gaza, either developed by children and/or youth or presented for them were centred on national identity, strengthening of Palestinian cultural heritage, youth employment, freedom of expression, women issues , etc. Training workshops in artistic fields, formal and informal educational settings included implementation of curriculum with strong emphasis on freedom of expression and the right to free speech and relevant democratic values were the focus of these activities. The Network focuses on enhancing the capacities and resources of the various performing arts organisations and their professional staff in areas like music teaching methods, development of management and artistic resources is a good progress marker. The said achievements have significantly contributed to the overall intended outcome of contributing to the development of a democratic and pluralistic society.
